in_english.name: Karylin
in_english.meaning: Feminine name derived from American name, means sweet and lovely
in_english.long_meaning: The name Karylin is derived from the American name Karylin, which is itself derived from the name Carolus. Carolus was originally a masculine name, but in American culture it has been feminized and has become popular. Karylin is a feminine name that is used in American culture and has spiritual significance in the Christian tradition, symbolizing sweetness and loveliness.
